scope.en: The separately authorized evolutionary-theory programme, made visible in the shared README by Ren; its theoretical focus does not displace other sessions. Ren directs the current organizing-variation continuation to social/organizational systems on 8 October 2026, with no new biological-system examples. On 9 October Ren requires systems thinking: differentiation and feedback within one system and its subsystems, without independently constituted entities connected afterward.
scope.zh: 独立获授权的演化理论研究；Ren 要求将其展示于共同 README。其理论重点不替代其他会话范围。 Ren 于2026年10月8日要求本次组织变异接续改用社会／组织，停止新增生物系统案例。 10月9日明确以同一系统与其子系统的分化和反馈解释，避免预设独立实体再接合。

objective.en: Establish a generative theory of evolution with a connected account of organization, transmission, reconstruction, development and changing selection, and demonstrate its explanatory and comparative strength.
objective.zh: 建立生成性的演化理论，接通组织、传递、重构、发育与变化中的选择，并说明其解释及比较优势。

premises.en: Begin with one relational unfolding; retain local laws, inheritance and selection correspondence. Evolutionary success supplies no ethical authority. The active theoretical comparison concerns explicit premises and recovery of established results; new measurements are not its completion gate.
premises.zh: 从同一关系展开开始，保留局部规律、遗传与选择对应。演化成功不提供伦理权威。当前理论比较关注公开前提与既有结果的恢复；新测量不是其完成门槛。

completion.en: The full evolutionary and comparative claim remains active. Credit completed local derivations at their stated scope and complete the remaining organizing-variation and selection connections. Keep the broader empirical programme separate from the current theoretical comparison.
completion.zh: 完整演化及比较主张仍在推进。按原范围复用已完成局部推导，继续组织变异及选择的剩余连接；更广经验计划与本轮理论比较分别保留。

title.zh: 论证 The Theory of Evolution

summary.zh: 从社会组织中共同活动的分化与反馈解释组织变异及其接续。既有条件程序证明保留；最新修正明确它尚未接通工作、能力、参与和组织边界的相互变化。完整解释及比较主张仍在推进。
summary.en: Explain organizing variation and continuation through differentiation and feedback in social activity. The existing conditional protocol proof remains valid; the systems correction identifies its unclosed dynamics of work, capability, participation and organizational boundaries. The full explanatory and comparative claim remains active.

next_step.zh: 接通被组织方式支持的实际活动，怎样反过来形成、改变或损伤其持续与再组织的条件；同等证据下比较系统动力学及组织惯例的强解释。
next_step.en: Connect enabled activity to the formation, transformation or loss of the conditions for its continuation and reorganization; compare strong system-dynamics and routine accounts on the same evidence.
